description: This file contains linear interpolation algorithms, binary search implementations, and performance testing code for interpolation functions in a firmware project.

classes.name: FastInterpolation
classes.description: A class for fast linear interpolation between two points, with methods to initialize and get interpolated values.

methods.name: needInterpolationLogging
methods.description: Returns the current logging flag value for interpolation.

methods.name: FastInterpolation::FastInterpolation
methods.description: Constructors for FastInterpolation class, initializing with default or specified points.

methods.name: FastInterpolation::init
methods.description: Initializes the interpolation parameters based on two points.

methods.name: FastInterpolation::getValue
methods.description: Returns interpolated value for a given x.

methods.name: interpolateMsg
methods.description: Performs linear interpolation between two points with optional message context.

methods.name: interpolateClamped
methods.description: Performs clamped linear interpolation between two points.

methods.name: findIndex2
methods.description: Binary search implementation for finding index in a sorted float array, optimized for power-of-two sizes.

methods.name: ensureArrayIsAscending
methods.description: Checks if array is sorted in ascending order, logs error if not.

methods.name: findIndexMsg
methods.description: Binary search returning the highest index where array[i] >= value.

methods.name: findIndex
methods.description: Wrapper for findIndexMsg with default message.

methods.name: interpolate2d
methods.description: Performs 1D table lookup with linear interpolation.

methods.name: setCurveValue
methods.description: Sets a specific value in a correction curve based on key.

methods.name: initInterpolation
methods.description: Initializes interpolation system with shared logger and optional binary test registration.
